invalid_controller_token.title: The Agent controller credential is invalid
invalid_controller_token.description: The local runner received an empty or unsupported credential for the Agent controller. The controller was not started.
invalid_controller_token.recovery: Check the local Agent account configuration before starting a run. Keep credentials out of the graph and its inputs.

executor_selection_mismatch.title: The Agent selected a different tool environment
executor_selection_mismatch.description: The requested tool environment did not match the executor assigned to this run. The runner refused that selection.
executor_selection_mismatch.recovery: Check the existing run status and cleanup, then check the local runner configuration before starting new work.

executor_registration_rejected.title: The Agent could not confirm its tool executor
executor_registration_rejected.description: The controller did not confirm registration of the tool executor. Tool execution is not ready.
executor_registration_rejected.recovery: Confirm the run status and container cleanup before starting new work. Check the local runner configuration if this persists.

executor_not_registered.title: The Agent tool executor is not ready
executor_not_registered.description: The runner requested a tool environment before its executor registration was confirmed.
executor_not_registered.recovery: Check the existing run status and local runner configuration. Confirm cleanup before starting another run.

request_timeout.title: The Agent did not respond in time
request_timeout.description: The runner did not receive a response to an Agent request before its deadline. The request may still be active.
request_timeout.recovery: If a run started, confirm its status and cleanup before starting another. For metadata-only requests, check the runner is ready before refreshing.

absolute_local_source_required.title: The local source needs an absolute path
absolute_local_source_required.description: A relative path cannot identify an admitted local skill source.
absolute_local_source_required.recovery: Select an absolute local path within the configured allowed source roots.

json_required.title: The source request format is invalid
json_required.description: The local source endpoint requires a JSON request.
json_required.recovery: Use the configured application client or send the supported JSON request format.

local_source_invalid.title: The local source address is invalid
local_source_invalid.description: The local source URI contains unsupported address parts.
local_source_invalid.recovery: Use an absolute local directory path or a supported file URI.

local_source_not_allowed.title: This local source is not allowed
local_source_not_allowed.description: The selected directory is outside the configured source roots.
local_source_not_allowed.recovery: Select a directory within an allowed root or update the local source service configuration.

local_source_unavailable.title: The local skill source is unavailable
local_source_unavailable.description: The selected local directory could not be used as an admitted source.
local_source_unavailable.recovery: Check that the selected source directory exists and is accessible within an allowed root.

local_source_unsafe.title: The local source could not be read safely
local_source_unsafe.description: The source contains a redirected path or does not meet the local source boundary.
local_source_unsafe.recovery: Select an allowed directory containing ordinary files and directories.

skill_name_invalid.title: The skill name is invalid
skill_name_invalid.description: The skill's declared name cannot be used as a registry identity.
skill_name_invalid.recovery: Use the supported lowercase letters, digits, hyphens and underscores in the skill name.

skill_operation_refused.title: The skill operation was refused
skill_operation_refused.description: The local service could not accept this Skill operation; private parser and authorization details were withheld.
skill_operation_refused.recovery: Inspect the selected revision and proposed edits. Confirm the existing operation outcome before submitting another change.

skill_operation_service_not_configured.title: The skill operation service is not configured
skill_operation_service_not_configured.description: The local operation service address or requested action is invalid.
skill_operation_service_not_configured.recovery: Check the configured local Skill operation service before using editing or history actions.

skill_operation_unavailable.title: The skill operation result is unavailable
skill_operation_unavailable.description: The application could not confirm a usable response from the local Skill operation service.
skill_operation_unavailable.recovery: Check local service availability and inspect the existing revision/history before submitting another edit.

source_bundle_invalid.title: The skill bundle is incomplete or unsupported
source_bundle_invalid.description: The selected bundle does not meet the supported Skill file structure and limits.
source_bundle_invalid.recovery: Select a complete skill directory containing SKILL.md.

source_required.title: Choose a skill source
source_required.description: No usable skill source was supplied.
source_required.recovery: Enter a supported repository URL or an allowed absolute local path on the Skill node.

source_unavailable.title: The skill source could not be read
source_unavailable.description: The source service could not safely complete this request.
source_unavailable.recovery: Check the selected source and local source service availability before refreshing read-only choices.

bundle_not_regular.title: The handoff bundle is not a regular file
bundle_not_regular.description: The local publication stage refused the run's fixed handoff file because it is missing, redirected or not a regular file.
bundle_not_regular.recovery: Check the existing run and publication attempt before starting new work. A refused capture does not authorize publishing or retrying an uncertain remote operation.

bundle_size_or_type.title: The handoff bundle was refused
bundle_size_or_type.description: The local publication stage refused the handoff file because its type, link count or size is outside the supported limits.
bundle_size_or_type.recovery: Check the existing run and publication attempt before starting new work. A refused capture does not authorize publishing or retrying an uncertain remote operation.

bundle_changed_or_oversized.title: The handoff bundle changed while being read
bundle_changed_or_oversized.description: The local publication stage could not retain stable, bounded bytes from the handoff file. This capture was refused.
bundle_changed_or_oversized.recovery: Check the existing run and publication attempt before starting new work. A refused capture does not authorize publishing or retrying an uncertain remote operation.

bundle_unreadable.title: The handoff bundle could not be read
bundle_unreadable.description: The local publication stage encountered a filesystem error while reading the run's fixed handoff file. This capture was refused.
bundle_unreadable.recovery: Check the existing run and publication attempt before starting new work. A refused capture does not authorize publishing or retrying an uncertain remote operation.

unsafe_relative_path.title: A skill file path is unsafe
unsafe_relative_path.description: A skill file path is absolute, contains an unsupported separator or attempts to leave its skill folder. The registry refused that path.
unsafe_relative_path.recovery: Use relative file paths inside the skill, then select or import a verified revision.

invalid_tree_root.title: The skill folder is unavailable
invalid_tree_root.description: The registry could not use the expected skill folder as a regular directory. It may be missing or linked to another location.
invalid_tree_root.recovery: Check the selected skill source and registry files before selecting or importing a verified revision.

linked_path.title: The skill contains a linked path
linked_path.description: The registry found a symbolic link, junction or reparse point inside the skill folder and refused to follow it.
linked_path.recovery: Use a skill revision containing regular files and folders without links.

special_file.title: The skill contains an unsupported file
special_file.description: The registry found a filesystem entry that is not a regular file or directory. It refused to include that entry in the skill.
special_file.recovery: Remove unsupported filesystem entries from the source and import a verified skill revision.

hardlinked_file.title: The skill contains a hard-linked file
hardlinked_file.description: A skill file shares its filesystem contents with another path. The registry refused it because another path could change those bytes.
hardlinked_file.recovery: Use independent regular files in the source and import a verified skill revision.

missing_skill_file.title: The skill is missing SKILL.md
missing_skill_file.description: The expected skill folder does not contain its required SKILL.md file. The registry could not verify a complete skill revision.
missing_skill_file.recovery: Check the selected source or registry revision and use a skill with a SKILL.md file at its root.

empty_directory.title: The skill contains an empty folder
empty_directory.description: The registry found an empty folder that cannot be represented by the skill file inventory. It refused the tree.
empty_directory.recovery: Remove empty folders from the source or add their intended files, then import a verified skill revision.

invalid_revision_id.title: The skill revision reference is invalid
invalid_revision_id.description: The selected skill revision does not have the immutable hash format required by the registry. The runner refused to read that revision.
invalid_revision_id.recovery: Select an existing immutable revision on the Skill node before starting new work.

latest_pointer_integrity_failure.title: The latest skill reference is inconsistent
latest_pointer_integrity_failure.description: The registry latest pointer does not match its recorded tree identity. The runner refused to use that reference.
latest_pointer_integrity_failure.recovery: Select a known immutable revision, or restore the registry from a trusted copy before starting new work.

revision_integrity_failure.title: The skill revision failed its integrity check
revision_integrity_failure.description: The selected revision metadata or file bytes no longer match its immutable identity. The runner refused to use those contents.
revision_integrity_failure.recovery: Use a verified immutable revision or restore the registry from a trusted copy before starting new work.

file_not_in_revision.title: The file is not part of the skill revision
file_not_in_revision.description: The requested file is not listed in the selected immutable skill revision. The registry refused the read.
file_not_in_revision.recovery: Check the selected skill revision and use its recorded files. Restore inconsistent registry metadata from a trusted copy before starting new work.

skill_revision_unavailable.title: The selected skill revision is unavailable
skill_revision_unavailable.description: The registry could not provide a verified bundle for this exact revision. Its files may be absent or may not match the saved record.
skill_revision_unavailable.recovery: Close the file viewer and select an available revision in the Skill node. Keep the original reference if reporting the missing revision.

skill_revision_unsafe.title: The skill revision cannot be safely displayed
skill_revision_unsafe.description: The file viewer refused linked or unsupported files in the selected bundle.
skill_revision_unsafe.recovery: Close the file viewer and select a verified revision. The viewer cannot repair this immutable bundle; do not bypass its file checks.

skill_revision_too_large.title: The skill revision exceeds the viewer limits
skill_revision_too_large.description: The selected bundle exceeds the file size, total size, count or nesting limits for inspection.
skill_revision_too_large.recovery: Close the file viewer and select a smaller registered revision. Reloading this immutable bundle does not reduce its size.

skill_inspection_unavailable.title: Skill files could not be loaded
skill_inspection_unavailable.description: The file viewer did not receive a confirmed snapshot. The reason has not been established.
skill_inspection_unavailable.recovery: Reload files repeats only the read of this selection. It does not edit the skill, rerun the graph or start an agent. You can also close the viewer.

skill_history_unavailable.title: Skill history could not be loaded
skill_history_unavailable.description: The viewer did not receive confirmed history for this selection. The reason has not been established; current files remain available.
skill_history_unavailable.recovery: Reload history repeats only the history read. It does not submit an edit, rerun the graph or start an agent. You can continue viewing current files.

skill_comparison_unavailable.title: The skill comparison could not be loaded
skill_comparison_unavailable.description: The viewer could not confirm the selected revision comparison. The reason has not been established.
skill_comparison_unavailable.recovery: Select Current source to return to the current files, or choose another revision in the history. Viewing a comparison does not edit the skill or run the graph.

skill_summary_source_unavailable.title: The skill description source is unavailable
skill_summary_source_unavailable.description: The preparation step could not read SKILL.md as text, so it could not prepare description-authoring instructions.
skill_summary_source_unavailable.recovery: Select a registered revision with a readable text SKILL.md and inspect it before preparing an edit. This preparation failure does not publish a revision.

skill_operation_invalid.title: The proposed skill edit is invalid
skill_operation_invalid.description: The proposal did not meet the required modify action, explanation or file-edit format and limits. It was refused before application.
skill_operation_invalid.recovery: Correct the proposed action, message and file edits before submitting again. Inspect existing history before repeating an earlier request whose outcome is uncertain.

skill_editor_invalid.title: The skill edit attribution is invalid
skill_editor_invalid.description: The host-supplied editing identity did not meet the supported provenance format or field limits.
skill_editor_invalid.recovery: Keep the existing revision and report the safe technical details to the application maintainer. Do not invent attribution fields in the proposed edit.
